name: Marc Lou
dm:
Hey Marc — big fan of your build-in-public journey with ShipFast.

You often talk about how founders bleed cash on monthly SaaS subscriptions. We just built and open-sourced OpenExplee to completely eliminate the $200–$300/mo bill people pay Explee & Apollo for basic web scraping and cold email.

1-command Docker setup, natural language ICP search, live SMTP handshake verification ($0), and AI personalization via Gemini/Ollama.

Code is free under MIT: https://github.com/vikasvardhanv/openexplee

Thought your indie founder community would love saving $2,400/yr. Keep crushing it!

name: Greg Isenberg
angle: Unbundling SaaS into open-source cash engines
dm:
Hey Greg — love your frameworks on unbundling SaaS into open-source opportunities.

We saw founders paying $300/month for Explee/Apollo/Instantly just to scrape websites and send emails, so we built the open-source counterpart: OpenExplee.

It does natural language ICP search, 4-tier live mailbox verification, and multi-inbox rotation with local LLM support.

Just dropped the repo on GitHub: https://github.com/vikasvardhanv/openexplee

Would love your quick thoughts if this fits the unbundling playbook!

name: Logan Kilpatrick

name: Alex Berman
dm:
Hey Alex — watched your cold email case studies for years.

Most cold email SaaS platforms charge $100–$300/mo and lock users into shared sending pools that ruin deliverability. We just open-sourced OpenExplee (https://github.com/vikasvardhanv/openexplee).

It enforces a secondary domain firewall (SPF/DKIM/DMARC auditor), free 4-tier SMTP mailbox verification, and multi-inbox rotation across Google Workspace / M365.

Would love your perspective on how we set up the deliverability guardrails!
